assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack
There is a concern for paroxysmal arrhythmia contributing to symptoms and potential stroke risk
A cardiac event monitor is ordered to capture rhythm data during symptomatic episodes
CPT 93271 is the cardiac event monitor code
The service aligns with diagnosis code I49.9
The service aligns with diagnosis code I34.0
The service aligns with diagnosis code Z86.73
The service directly supports the clinical need for continuous rhythm monitoring as described in the indication note
